quests.title: Political Philosopher Quest
quests.description: Explore fundamental questions about politics, freedom, and justice!

story.introduction: The Academy of Political Thought needs your help to resolve great philosophical debates about freedom, equality, and justice!

steps.title: The Great Freedom Debate
steps.narrative: Join the debate between different philosophers about the nature of freedom.

problem.question: According to Isaiah Berlin, what is the difference between negative and positive liberty?
problem.sample_answer: Negative liberty is freedom FROM external constraints, while positive liberty is freedom TO achieve one's potential...
problem.explanation: Students should explain negative liberty as absence of obstacles and positive liberty as capacity for self-realization.
